packages.name: Knee Replacement Surgery
packages.description: Complete knee replacement surgery with post-operative care and physiotherapy

faqs.question: What is the recovery time for knee replacement?
faqs.answer: Most patients can return to normal activities within 6-8 weeks, with full recovery taking 3-6 months.

faqs.question: Are there different types of knee implants?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer both imported and domestic implants with varying durability and cost options.

packages.name: Normal Delivery Package
packages.description: Comprehensive normal delivery package with pre and post-natal care
exclusions: Additional tests not included in package

faqs.question: What if I need a C-section during delivery?
faqs.answer: Emergency C-section charges are separate and will be discussed with you beforehand.

faqs.question: Is newborn care included in the package?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic newborn care for 48 hours and essential screening tests are included.

packages.name: Full Body Health Checkup
packages.description: Comprehensive health screening with 50+ tests and specialist consultations

faqs.question: Do I need to fast before the checkup?
faqs.answer: Yes, 10-12 hours fasting is required for accurate blood sugar and lipid profile results.

faqs.question: How long does the complete checkup take?
faqs.answer: The entire process takes 4-6 hours including all tests and consultations.

packages.name: Cataract Surgery
packages.description: Advanced cataract surgery with premium IOL options and post-operative care

faqs.question: What are the different IOL options available?
faqs.answer: We offer basic monofocal, premium multifocal, and toric IOLs for astigmatism correction.

faqs.question: Is the surgery painful?
faqs.answer: No, the surgery is performed under local anesthesia and is virtually painless.

packages.name: C-Section Delivery Package
packages.description: Planned or emergency cesarean delivery with comprehensive maternal and newborn care

faqs.question: What is the recovery time for C-section?
faqs.answer: Most mothers can resume normal activities in 6-8 weeks with proper rest and care.

faqs.question: Can I have a normal delivery after C-section?
faqs.answer: VBAC (Vaginal Birth After Cesarean) is possible in many cases, depending on individual factors.

packages.name: Cardiac Health Package
packages.description: Comprehensive heart health screening with advanced cardiac tests and specialist consultation

faqs.question: Who should get a cardiac health checkup?
faqs.answer: Anyone above 35 years, or those with family history of heart disease, diabetes, or high blood pressure.

faqs.question: How often should I get a cardiac checkup?
faqs.answer: Annual checkups are recommended for high-risk individuals, every 2-3 years for others.
